Become a Member

Membership is simple.

At Crosspoint, we look at membership in a pretty simple way:
if you are in relationship with Christ, then you belong to this community and we welcome you.
Once a quarter, Crosspoint offers our membership class. This class is a simple and brief introduction to our culture, mission, and values.

At the class, you'll join with other new members, pastoral staff, and the elders to explore Crosspoint, join in the mission, and start being known and included at Crosspoint!
